Preview by AkshayaKrishna Polya The calm before the storm. Leicestershire Foxes take on Derbyshire Falcons at Grace Road , Leicester , in the T20 Blast North Group fixture on Wednesday (May 27). Just a solitary game in the mid-week mania before we move towards the weekend. Both teams are desperate to open their winning account this season. The Falcons have been unlucky to lose two close games against Durham and Yorkshire Vikings. While the Foxes have also tasted two defeats at the hands of Worcestershire Rapids and Durham. Despite the lack of returns, the hosts have named an unchanged squad for this vital encounter. While Rory Haydon has been added to the visitors' squad. Losing wickets at regular intervals, Leicestershire were restricted to 148/8 by Durham in the last game. Opener Sol Budinger top-scored with a 34-ball 40, while Nicky Kelly and Ashton Turner scored in the high 20s. The Foxes failed to pick up early wickets, allowing Durham openers to take the game away from them. Ben, Mike, and Liam Trevaskis took a couple of wickets each, but by then, the game had already drifted away from the Foxes' hands as they saw their opposition chase down in just 14 overs. That massive defeat dropped them to the bottom of the table. After a six-run loss to Durham, Derbyshire endured another narrow defeat at the hands of Yorkshire by two wickets in a humdinger of a contest at Leeds. The Falcons posted 194/4 in 20 overs on the back of a brilliant, unbeaten 81 off 56 balls from Martin Andersson. Ross Whiteley and Matthew Montgomery were also excellent with their fiery cameos, taking the team's score close to the 200-run mark. Jack Morely bowled a dream spell, scalping 4/44; Nick Potts took two wickets, and Montgomery delivered a crazy four-over spell in a high-scoring game to finish with 1/21. Akif Javed took 1/39 as well, but Derbyshire still bottled the match big time. They reduced Yorkshire to 139/8 in 15.3 overs, but a miracle partnership between Andrew Tye and Hasan Ali turned things around dramatically and took the game away from the Falcons. With the first points of the season on the line, both teams are expected to fight hard. Who will win this exhilarating contest? To find out, join us at 10 PM IST, 5:30 PM Local Time, on Wednesday for its live coverage!
Leicestershire Foxes Probable XI: Stephen Eskinazi, Sol Budinger, Rishi Patel, Nick Kelly, Ashton Turner, Ben Cox (wk), Ben Green (c), Liam Trevaskis, Ben Mike, Josh Davey, Josh Hull

Derbyshire Falcons Probable XI : Aneurin Donald (c/wk), Martin Andersson, Caleb Jewell, Wayne Madsen, Matthew Montgomery, Ross Whiteley, Amrit Basra, Nick Potts, Ben Aitchison, Akif Javed, Jack Morley
